info.name: HPE OmniStack REST backups hosts API
Retrieves all hosts defined on this system

params.name: show_optional_fields
params.description:
An indicator to show the capacity metrics of the host

Note: These values are computed from various sources. Consequently, the retrieval of these values may adversely affect the response time of a request.

params.name: id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the host

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: name
params.description:
The name of the host

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: type
params.description:
The type of host

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: model
params.description:
The model of the host

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: version
params.description:
The version of the host

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: hypervisor_management_system
params.description:
The IP address of the Hypervisor Management System (HMS) associated with the host

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: hypervisor_management_system_name
params.description:
The name of the Hypervisor Management System (HMS) associated with the host

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: hypervisor_object_id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the hypervisor-based instance associated with the host

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: compute_cluster_name
params.description:
The name of the compute cluster associated with the host

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: compute_cluster_hypervisor_object_id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the Hypervisor Management System (HMS) for the associated compute cluster

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: management_ip
params.description:
The IP address of the HPE OmniStack management module that runs on the host

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: storage_ip
params.description:
The IP address of the HPE OmniStack storage module that runs on the host

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: federation_ip
params.description:
The IP address of the federation

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: virtual_controller_name
params.description:
The name of the Virtual Controller that runs on the host

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: compute_cluster_parent_name
params.description:
The name of the hypervisor-based instance that contains the omnistack_cluster that is associated with the instance

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: compute_cluster_parent_hypervisor_object_id
params.description:
The unique identifier (UID) of the hypervisor-based instance that contains the omnistack_cluster that is associated with the instance

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list, pattern using one or more asterisk characters as a wildcard

params.name: policy_enabled
params.description:
An indicator to show the status of the backup policy for the host

Valid values:

True: The backup policy for the host is enabled.

False: The backup policy for the host is disabled.

params.name: current_feature_level_min
params.description: The minimum current feature level of the HPE OmniStack software running on the host

params.name: current_feature_level_max
params.description: The maximum current feature level of the HPE OmniStack software running on the host

params.name: potential_feature_level_min
params.description: The minimum potential feature level of the HPE OmniStack software running on the host

params.name: potential_feature_level_max
params.description: The maximum potential feature level of the HPE OmniStack software running on the host

params.name: cluster_feature_level_min
params.description: The minimum cluster feature level of the HPE OmniStack software running on the host

params.name: cluster_feature_level_max
params.description: The maximum cluster feature level of the HPE OmniStack software running on the host

params.name: upgrade_state
params.description:
The state of the most recent HPE OmniStack software upgrade for this host (SUCCESS, FAIL, IN_PROGRESS, NOOP, UNKNOWN)

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: can_rollback
params.description:
An indicator to show if the current HPE OmniStack software running on the host can roll back to the previous version

Valid values:

True: The current HPE OmniStack software for the host can roll back to the previous version.

False: The current HPE OmniStack software for the host cannot roll back to the previous version.

params.name: omnistack_cluster_id
params.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the omnistack_cluster associated with the host

params.name: state
params.description: The current state of the host

params.name: cluster_group_id
params.description:
The unique identifiers (UIDs) of the cluster_groups associated with the hosts to return

Accepts: Single value, comma-separated list

params.name: availability_zone_planned
params.description: The planned-assigned availability zone. This will become the effectively-assigned zone once the zone changes are realized.

params.name: availability_zone_effective
params.description: The effectively-assigned availability zone

params.name: fields
params.description:
A comma-separated list of fields to include in the returned objects

 Default: Returns all fields

params.name: limit
params.description:
A positive integer that represents the maximum number of results to return

Default: 500

params.name: offset
params.description:
A positive integer that directs the service to start returning the <offset value> instance, up to the limit

Default: 0

params.name: case
params.description:
An indicator that specifies if the filter and sort results use a case-sensitive or insensitive manner

Valid values: sensitive or insensitive

Default: sensitive

params.name: sort
params.description: The name of the field where the sort occurs

params.name: order
params.description:
The sort order preference

Valid values: ascending or descending

Default: descending
